about.en: ARG is the official fan token of the Argentine Football Association (AFA) and its national football team. It is issued by Socios.com (Chiliz) as a CAP-20 token on Chiliz Chain at 0x4394886B1eec08Fe88681462914702dC99D97Eb7 and gives holders voting rights in team polls, rewards and fan-engagement features; it carries no ownership of the association.
